$schema.description: The JSON Schema for this file.

apiVersion.description: The Salesforce REST API version to describe with, e.g. "v66.0". Exported as API_VERSION in the generated file.

output.description: The generated TypeScript file, relative to this config file.

sobjects.description: The sObjects to generate types for. Without it, every queryable sObject is generated.

auth.description: How the generator logs in. Fill in the credentials as "${NAME}" placeholders, which are read from the environment (e.g. loaded with --env-file .env). Keys you leave out are read from the default SF_* variables; without auth, client credentials come from SF_LOGIN_URL, SF_CLIENT_ID and SF_CLIENT_SECRET.

loginUrl.description: Your My Domain URL, or "${NAME}" to read it from the environment. Defaults to the SF_LOGIN_URL variable.

clientId.description: The consumer key, or "${NAME}" to read it from the environment. Defaults to the SF_CLIENT_ID variable.

clientSecret.description: The consumer secret as "${NAME}", read from the environment. Defaults to the SF_CLIENT_SECRET variable.

accessToken.description: The access token as "${NAME}", read from the environment. Defaults to the SF_ACCESS_TOKEN variable.

instanceUrl.description: The org's instance URL, or "${NAME}" to read it from the environment. Defaults to the SF_INSTANCE_URL variable.

loginUrl.description: The login or My Domain URL, or "${NAME}" to read it from the environment. Defaults to the SF_LOGIN_URL variable.

clientId.description: The consumer key, or "${NAME}" to read it from the environment. Defaults to the SF_CLIENT_ID variable.

username.description: The username to act as, or "${NAME}" to read it from the environment. Defaults to the SF_USERNAME variable.

privateKey.description: The PEM key itself as "${NAME}", read from the environment. Defaults to the SF_PRIVATE_KEY variable.

privateKeyPath.description: A path to the PEM key file, used when privateKey is empty. Defaults to the SF_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH variable.

targetOrg.description: The Salesforce CLI org alias or username, or "${NAME}" to read it from the environment. Defaults to the CLI's default org.

excludeCreateFields.description: Per sObject, fields to leave out of the create input.

excludeUpdateFields.description: Per sObject, fields to leave out of the update input.

picklists.description: "union" (default): picklists become unions of their values. "string": plain strings. "const": a union plus a named const object and type per picklist, e.g. CaseStatus.Working. "enum": a TypeScript enum per picklist; restricted picklists then only accept enum members.

constants.description: Emit the PICKLIST_VALUES and RECORD_TYPES runtime constants. Defaults to true.

continueOnDescribeError.description: Skip sObjects whose describe fails instead of failing the run. Defaults to false.

importSource.description: Where the generated file imports helper types from. Defaults to "@cerios/salesforce-sobjectly".

deprecatedEnvName.description: Deprecated: the name of the environment variable to read. Removed in 2.0.
